name: The Absent Minded Prospector
summary: In Darkshore, Remtravel's excavations set a search in motion. In Menethil Harbor, Archaeologist Flagongut hopes to join Remtravel's finds with his own fossil and the lost Stone of Relu to reveal the relics' hidden powers.

sections.title: Cross-Continental Archaeology
sections.body: You once helped the distracted Prospector Remtravel during an escort through northern Darkshore. His search now reaches across the Great Sea to the Wetlands marshes, where Prospector Whelgar keeps Flagongut's original fossil at his excavation site. After reviewing the collected finds, Archaeologist Flagongut believes a key artifact, the Stone of Relu, can unlock the mysterious powers within the fossils.

sections.title: Lost to the Marshes
sections.body: Before Flagongut could meet Whelgar, mottled raptors ambushed his caravan along the road and swallowed the Stone of Relu. To piece together the mystery, Flagongut needs you to hunt the beasts, recover the stone, and retrieve his original fossil from Whelgar's camp. With both fossils and the key assembled, the dwarven researchers hope to learn the relics' true origin and power.

faq.q: Why is a Darkshore quest ending in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: The Explorers' League works across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker sent Remtravel's fossil from Darkshore across the sea to Archaeologist Flagongut in the Wetlands, joining the two dig sites through shared research.

faq.q: What is the Stone of Relu?
faq.answer: The Stone of Relu is an ancient relic recovered by Archaeologist Flagongut. He believes it can act as a cipher or catalyst, unlocking dormant magical secrets preserved in the fossils excavated in Darkshore and the Wetlands.

Archaeologist Flagongut is an operative of the dwarven Explorers' League, based in Menethil Harbor. He studies ancient relics from nearby excavations and hopes to unlock the hidden power in fossils found by Prospectors Remtravel and Whelgar.
Prospector Whelgar holds Flagongut's original fossil at his excavation site in the Wetlands. You have already delivered Remtravel's Darkshore fossil to Flagongut.

faq.q: Why do raptors have the Stone of Relu?
faq.answer: While traveling along the Wetlands road to consult Prospector Whelgar, Flagongut was ambushed by mottled raptors. In the chaos, one of the beasts swallowed the stone whole.

faq.q: What do the dwarves expect the fossils to do?
faq.answer: Flagongut believes the fossils hold hidden power and secrets of the past, and that the Stone of Relu is the key to unlocking them.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see the Explorers' League at work, linking distant dig sites across continents to piece together dwarven heritage and the mysteries of the Titans.
As an Alliance adventurer, you may help bridge the sea between the night elven lands of Darkshore and the dwarven settlements around Menethil Harbor, alongside Alliance couriers.
